This version has limits: it cannot read encrypted (TLS) traffic, does not keep packet contents, and cannot always tell which app sent a connection.

A local VPN can observe destination IP, time, byte counts, and limited plaintext DNS metadata. The current built-in proxy cannot attribute traffic to an app. Events are count-bounded and process-local, not a durable seven-day history; process death or Clear removes them. No traffic or history is uploaded. Android permits one VPN at a time; starting this can replace another VPN. Stop is always available here and in the persistent notification.

APK Sentinel is for devices, apps, files, accounts, networks, and traffic you own or are explicitly authorized to test. Evidence and scores are guidance, never a guarantee of safety, malware, authenticity, privacy, or legal compliance.

Device posture and settings guidance · installed-app installer, update, signing, permission, and component evidence with local statistics · base, split-set, and icon export · full analysis of selected or installed base APKs · SHA-1/SHA-256 signing evidence · readable manifest search/export · SDK, permission, component, DEX/native/assets, tracker/endpoint evidence · installed-version comparison · bounded local reports · safe non-opening URL checks · consented redirect resolution · official fraud-report handoff.

A user-started local VPN is activated only when the installed forwarding engine confirms the requested IP families and firewall mode. The Network screen shows the engine\'s actual capability report. A parser, Terms entry, or planned feature is never presented as active monitoring or protection.

Raw packets, payload views, TLS/user-certificate inspection, already-rooted-device capture, and paired remote streaming are available only when the exact runtime capability is present and separately disclosed on its own start screen. Otherwise they remain visibly unavailable. APK Sentinel never roots a device, silently installs a certificate, or starts a capture or stream from Terms acceptance.

No account, advertising SDK, data sale, mandatory upload, or silent traffic/history upload. Optional database updates, reputation lookups, paired receiver sessions, reports, diagnostics, and analytics use their own disclosed routes and controls. Exported files remain under the selected storage provider or recipient\'s control.

Accepting general Terms never grants VPN, payload, TLS, root, streaming, online lookup, diagnostic, or analytics consent. Android permission and consent surfaces remain authoritative and each sensitive tool requires its exact in-product disclosure and affirmative action.

This review build does not have configured publisher and policy details, so it cannot be published. The publisher\'s final legal entity, effective date, support/privacy contact, public privacy-policy URL, governing-law and consumer-rights language, and legal review remain release gates. These fields are not user consent.
